summary: This topic covers the process of logging into the ERP system, understanding the dashboard layout, identifying company and user information, and recognizing the permission-based menu structure.
steps: Navigate to the ERP URL: campus.audipay.org.
Log in using your phone number and a One-Time Password (OTP).
Optionally, set a permanent password for future logins.
Upon successful login, the dashboard will display your company's interface, entity name, user ID, and the current session.
business_rules: Menu options and access are based on user permissions.
important_notes: The ERP URL (campus.audipay.org) can be saved or attached to your homescreen for easy access.
questions: How do I log in to the ERP system?
